recipes.description: Xcode from a .xip you downloaded (next: Recipes/xcode-platforms for simulator runtimes)

inputs.description: an Xcode .xip from https://developer.apple.com/download/all/ (any Apple ID; Apple does not offer it without one)
inputs.name: xcode

recipes.name: xcode

notes.message: it has no update steps, so image update will not bring what it installs up to date

warnings.message: no step uses AGENT_VM_INPUT_XCODE, yet every build must give the file

recipes.description: Simulator runtimes and Xcode components (needs Xcode: build from an image with Recipes/xcode)
recipes.name: xcode-platforms

notes.message: it has no update steps, so image update will not bring what it installs up to date

parameters.description: Xcode components, separated by spaces; empty for none
parameters.name: components

parameters.description: simulator runtimes, separated by spaces: iOS, watchOS, tvOS or visionOS; about 8 GB each; empty for none
parameters.name: platforms

warnings.message: no step or check uses AGENT_VM_PARAM_COMPONENTS
no step or check uses AGENT_VM_PARAM_PLATFORMS
